name: RE-Agent VM
description: RE-Agent VM is the hardware-isolated variant of the RE-Agent appliance, built on a Debian or Ubuntu cloud image. Agentic reverse-engineering and malware-analysis workstation: Hermes Agent with the REA MCP server registered, Ghidra headless, OpenBin BINNY, CAPA, FLOSS, YARA, Detect It Easy, Radare2 and UPX, plus rea-case for evidence-backed case folders and re-firewall to restrict egress to an LLM proxy.

notes.text: Run 're-agent-setup' inside the guest to configure your model provider and start the Hermes gateway API on port 8642 (key in /home/analyst/.hermes/.env).
The Hermes dashboard listens on 127.0.0.1:9119. Reach it with: ssh -L 9119:127.0.0.1:9119 root@<IP>
Run 'rea-case new <sample>' to start a case in /work/cases.

Run 're-firewall isolate <proxy_ip> [port]' as root before handling samples. It blocks all egress except the analyst user to your proxy, blocks IPv6, and persists across reboots. A Squid template is in /opt/re-agent/host-egress-proxy.conf.
After setup, take a clean baseline snapshot: qm snapshot <vmid> baseline-clean
